AttrValue.description:
A world fact attached to an axis value, a decoration, or a rendered card.

Serialised untagged, so JSON carries the natural scalar (`true`, `5`,
`"text"`) with no wrapper. Deserialization tries `Flag`, then `Number`, then
`Text`, so a bool never lands as text and an integer never lands as a flag.

anyOf.description: An integer fact (e.g. an ordinal or a count).
A text fact (e.g. a partner id or a display label).

CardDeck.description:
A compiled card deck — a straight structural render of a ruleset under a
profile.

cards.description: The rendered cards, ordered by (layer declaration, id).

cited.description:
The ruleset's cited provenance, when the profile carries it (dev-metadata);
`None` when stripped.

layouts.description:
The layouts that compile — a layout survives iff its required cards are
present.

profile.description: The profile identity that produced it.

ContextPack.description:
The assembled context pack plus its inclusion/exclusion manifest — the shape
`pack.py`'s `ContextPack` emits.

est_tokens.description: The estimated token cost of the whole pack (`len(text) // 4`).

included.description: The units that fit the budget, in emission order.

skipped.description: The units dropped from the tail because the budget was exceeded.

text.description:
The concatenated pack text: `<!-- canon: … -->`-headed blocks joined by a
blank line.

DifferentialStatus.description: Whether the Ludii trace-agreement battery has been run.

oneOf.description:
The battery has not run: the Ludii runtime is a rented baseline in a
non-gating lane, not provisioned in the offline kernel.

blocker.description: Why the differential could not run.

oneOf.description: The engine render and the Ludii runtime agreed over the battery.

ExportEmission.description: The target-shaped artifacts available through this worker contract.

oneOf.description: A Ludii program and differential status.

commit.description: The source commit the export was built from.

profile_hash.description: A hash of the export profile and its options.

valuation.description: A fingerprint of the valuation the export was taken under.

LudiiExport.description:
A compiled Ludii `L-GDL` export: a straight structural render of the ruleset,
plus whether the trace-agreement differential ran.

profile.description: The profile identity that produced it.

PackedUnit.description:
One unit's placement in (or exclusion from) the pack — the analogue of
`pack.py`'s `PackedFile`.

est_tokens.description: The estimated token cost of the unit's rendered block.

layer.description: The layer it was drawn from (`certain` / `fork`) — the `status` analogue.

unit.description: The unit's identity — a source pack name (the `relpath` analogue).

RenderedCard.description:
One rendered card: the export id (from the render rule), its layer, and the
kept fields.

kept.description: The fields kept per the render rule's keep-list.

layer.description: The layer this card belongs to.
